title: Element-specific estimation of background mutation rates in whole cancer genomes through transfer learning.
summary: eMET transfer-learning/genomic interval methods estimate cancer background mutation rates across 2,253 pan-cancer genomes and 23 cancer-specific cohorts; it outperforms comparator estimators in 538/552 pairwise tests and is assessed for driver discovery. The specific result is a cancer-genomics method/analysis finding, not a newly validated driver mutation.
